summary: Flutter now expires a cached prejoin roster 10 seconds after its SSE stream is lost, matching the web stale-snapshot window. A fresh snapshot cancels expiration and clears the reconnect error.

checks.name: Regression for stale roster expiry
checks.observation: New state test first failed because the stale snapshot was not cleared within the injected 100 ms policy; after the fix it confirms that the roster expires and connection error is visible.

checks.name: Regression for recovery before expiry
checks.observation: A new SSE snapshot arrives before timeout; the stale timer is canceled and the recovered roster remains available without an error.

checks.name: Flutter application tests and analysis
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub --no-fatal-infos
checks.observation: All 328 tests passed; analyzer reported no issues.

checks.name: Android and macOS debug builds
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter build apk --debug --no-pub && flutter build macos --debug --no-pub
checks.observation: Both native debug builds completed. Android emitted the existing Flutter KGP migration warning; macOS emitted third-party flutter_soloud compiler warnings.

limits: No ADB/device runtime, live production reconnect, Windows build/runtime, or paired web/Flutter session test was performed.
